headline: Executive order aims to strengthen rules against human trafficking by companies that hold federal government contracts.
what_it_does: This order sets out stronger protections against human trafficking in work done under federal government contracts. No summary was provided, so the exact new rules, requirements, and penalties cannot be described here based on the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and subcontractors with federal contracts
who_it_affects.how: They are likely subject to stronger anti-trafficking rules when doing work paid for by the federal government.
They are the intended beneficiaries of stronger protections against trafficking and forced labor.
They are likely responsible for carrying out and enforcing the stronger protections in their contracts.
